product.name: London Hills Men's Ankle Length Denim Jeans
product.description: London Hills men's ankle-length denim jeans with a slim tapered silhouette, mid-rise construction and classic 5-pocket styling. Designed for casual, travel and everyday wear.

buying_advice.size_advice: Use the size chart before ordering. The listed sizes are numeric 28–36. Do not infer a different size mapping without a verified size chart.
buying_advice.style_advice: The ankle-length tapered silhouette is best suited to sneakers and casual footwear. It works well with T-shirts, casual shirts and hoodies.
buying_advice.quality_advice: Do not call the denim premium based solely on the listing. Customer feedback on fabric quality is mixed.
buying_advice.colour_advice: The available supplied images represent Dark Blue and Light Blue. Mention that at least one customer reported the delivered colour looking different from the photo.
buying_advice.sales_advice: Lead with slim tapered styling, ankle length, soft stretch, lightweight construction and casual versatility. Do not promise premium fabric quality or perfect colour accuracy.

source.model_name: London Hills Mens Slim Tapered Fit Mid Rise Jeans

shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_product: Describe it as a London Hills men's slim tapered ankle-length jean with mid-rise construction, cotton-blend denim and soft stretch.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_if_good: Recommend conditionally. The strongest evidence is positive feedback for fit, appearance and comfort. The main concerns are mixed fabric-quality feedback and colour-related complaints.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_quality: Say that quality feedback is mixed. Some customers report good quality, while others specifically criticize the fabric and inner material.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_fit: Use the detailed specification: Slim fit, tapered leg and mid rise. Mention that several customers report good or perfect fitting, but one customer reported a sizing problem.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_length: This is an ankle-length jean and is designed to sit shorter than a standard full-length jean.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_stretch: The product description explicitly says the cotton-blend denim has soft stretch.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_colors: The supplied product images represent Dark Blue and Light Blue.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_price: The supplied snapshot shows ₹741 against an MRP of ₹1,999, representing a 63% discount.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_washing: The listed care instruction is Machine Wash.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_for_size: Recommend checking the size chart. Available numeric sizes in the supplied listing are 28, 30, 32, 34 and 36.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_for_style: Recommend it for customers wanting a slim, tapered, ankle-length modern casual look.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_for_alternatives: For customers wanting relaxed, loose or straight-fit jeans, recommend other products instead of this one.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_for_best_product: Match strongly against slim-fit, tapered, ankle-length and stretch-jeans preferences. Penalize it for requests requiring premium fabric quality or highly accurate colour reproduction.
